notablePrerequisites:
Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Zombie.
description:
Activate Trazyn using The Golden Throne's ability by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {U}{U}{U} or {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Trazyn using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
